Examples.Title: Clean up unused images
Examples.Description: Remove unused sandbox image versions. Versions referenced by active deployments are preserved.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Delete a sandbox image
Examples.Description: Delete the image repository and all its tags. Reject deletion if any version is referenced by an active deployment. Return the deleted image.
Examples.Code:
### Delete a sandbox image
# @name DeleteImage
DELETE {{host}}/v1/sandboxes/images/{{image_name}}?team_id={{team_id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
X-Team-Id: {{X-Team-Id}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: Successful operation.
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Missing or invalid authentication. Returns a JSON error with code, message, and optional details.
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: List sandbox images
Examples.Description: Return one cursor-paginated page of image repository summaries. Tags are listed separately. Pages can be empty when non-sandbox repositories are excluded; follow pagination.cursor while pagination.has_more is true. Prefix search forces ascending name order.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Push a sandbox image
Examples.Description: With image supplied, import the registry image asynchronously. Otherwise return an upload URL for a ZIP source archive containing its Dockerfile and build context. Processing starts after upload. No sandbox is created. Poll the image until BUILT or FAILED.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Create a sandbox
Examples.Description: Create a sandbox with an optional client-provided name, generated by the server when omitted. The request waits briefly for deployment, then returns the created resource. Deployment may continue after the response; inspect status to determine readiness. Names belonging to failed or terminated sandboxes can be reused; an active sandbox reserves its name. To get started, set image to blaxel/base-image:latest, the built-in image with the sandbox execution API ready to use. It is available directly; no image build, push, or GET /v1/sandboxes/images is needed. Use the returned url to execute commands with the same Bearer API key.
Examples.Setup: This example assumes `using Baseten;` is in scope and `apiKey` contains the required credential.

Examples.Title: Delete a sandbox

Examples.Title: Update a sandbox
Examples.Description: Partially update configuration. Omitted fields remain unchanged; supplied arrays and maps replace their previous values. Structured objects update only supplied fields. Changes to image may reset running state. The name, memory, and network configuration are immutable after creation. Supplying memory or network returns 400, including unchanged, empty, or null values.
Examples.Code:
### Update a sandbox
# @name UpdateSandbox
PATCH {{host}}/v1/sandboxes/instances/{{sandbox_name}}?team_id={{team_id}}
Authorization: Bearer {{token}}
X-Team-Id: {{X-Team-Id}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

  "lifecycle": {
    "expiration_policies": [
      {
        "action": "DELETE",
        "type": "TTL_IDLE",
        "value": "24h"

        "type": "TTL_MAX_AGE",
        "value": "7d"
      },
      {
        "action": "DELETE",
        "type": "DATE",
        "value": "2026-09-23T21:26:58Z"
      }
    ],
    "terminated_retention": "24h"
  },
  "region": "us-pdx-1",
  "envs": [
    {
      "name": "NODE_ENV",
      "secret": false,
      "value": "production"
    },
    {
      "name": "PORT",
      "secret": false,
      "value": "3000"
    }
  ],
  "image": "blaxel/base-image:latest",

    {
